Lore

[edit | edit source]

Nox, Primordial Goddess of Night, is the darkness that exists before all things and lingers after their end. Mother to both light and shadow, she birthed the forces that shape existence, from love and dreams to death and despair, holding them all in equal measure. Silent and unseen, she moves at the edge of perception, a presence even the mightiest gods fear. Now she enters the battlefield to protect her children, whether they bring hope or ruin. Those drawn to Nox command control and disruption, trapping enemies in shadow and silencing their power before they can strike.

Abilities

[edit | edit source]
Basic Attack - Nox Basic Attack Notes:
  • Projectile stops on first target hit, and does not pass through walls
Fire a projectile that deals Magical Damage to the first enemy hit
  • Damage Scaling: 100% Strength + 20% Intelligence + 100% Attack Damage
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 0.48 meters
Ability Video


Passive - Flame of the Night | Gain Intelligence on Cast Notes:
  • Taking damage from an enemy god blows out a candle, at most once every 3 seconds
Each ability you cast lights a candle. Each lit candle increases your Intelligence
  • Intelligence Per Stack +5%
  • Max Stacks 4
Ability Video


1st Ability - Shadow Lock | Tether Root, Cripple, and Damage Over Time Notes:
  • This is a channeled ability
  • Stay in range to keep the lock. Crowd Control does not break the lock
  • The Root and Cripple ignore Crowd Control Reduction. Cleansing removes them, but the damage continues
  • This ability ticks 4 times over 2 seconds
  • This ability passes through and damages non-god enemies, and passes through walls, but stops on enemy gods
Send your shadow forward through walls, dealing Magical Damage to minions and jungle monsters it passes. If it hits an enemy god, it stops and you channel, Rooting and Crippling them and dealing Magical Damage over time
  • Damage Per Tick: 40 | 60 | 75 | 95 | 100
  • Damage Scaling Per Tick: 10% Intelligence
  • Minion Damage: 80 | 125 | 170 | 215 | 260
  • Minion Damage Scaling: 60% Intelligence
  • Root Duration: 2 seconds
  • Cripple Duration: 2 seconds
  • Range: 10.4 meters
  • Lock Break Range: 12.4 meters
  • Cooldown: 10 seconds
  • Cost: 50 | 55 | 60 | 65 | 70 mana
Ability Video


2nd Ability - Siphon Darkness | Area Damage and Silence, Slow on Exit Notes:
  • Cancels the channeled abilities of enemy gods on cast
Create a void of darkness at the target location. After a short delay it explodes, dealing Magical Damage and Silencing enemies inside. Enemy gods who walk out before it explodes take part of the explosion damage and are Slowed
  • Damage: 90 | 160 | 230 | 300 | 370
  • Damage Scaling: 80% Intelligence
  • Exit Damage: 50% of the Explosion Damage
  • Silence Duration: 2 seconds
  • Slow: 40 | 45 | 50 | 55 | 60%
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 3.2 meters
  • Cooldown: 13 seconds
  • Cost: 70 | 75 | 80 | 85 | 90 mana
Ability Video


3rd Ability - Shadow Step | Dash into Allies, Explode Notes:
  • Cancel the ability to leave the shadow early
  • You are Displacement Immune while Dashing
  • This ability passes through and damages all enemies, but stops on walls and allied gods
Dash forward, dealing Magical Damage to enemies in your path. If you hit an allied god, enter their shadow and travel with them. Leaving the shadow deals Magical Damage to enemies around you
  • Damage: 70 | 110 | 150 | 190 | 230
  • Damage Scaling: 70% Intelligence
  • Shadow Duration: 8 seconds
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Explosion Radius: 4 meters
  • Cooldown: 15 seconds
  • Cost: 75 mana
Ability Video


Ultimate - Night Terror | Projectile Area Damage, Silence, Weaken Notes:
  • You are CC Immune while casting
  • This ability ticks 6 times over 5 seconds
  • This ability passes through and damages non-god enemies, but stops on walls and enemy gods
Fire a vortex of darkness that passes through minions and explodes on the first enemy god, jungle boss or Titan it hits, or at max range. Enemies in the explosion take Magical Damage, then Magical Damage over time, and are Silenced. Enemies hit are Weakened, dealing less damage
  • Damage: 200 | 250 | 300 | 350 | 400
  • Damage Scaling: 30% Intelligence
  • Damage Per Tick: 20 | 25 | 30 | 35 | 40
  • Damage Scaling Per Tick: 10% Intelligence
  • Silence Duration: 3 seconds
  • Weaken: -30% Damage Dealt
  • Weaken Duration: 5 seconds
  • Range: 19.2 meters
  • Radius: 3.5 meters
  • Cooldown: 90 | 85 | 80 | 75 | 70 seconds
  • Cost: 100 mana
Ability Video
